description: Generate a rows×cols grid of quads (or outlined cells) with a single order↔chaos `disorder` knob: 0 = a perfect grid, 1 = full chaos. The one knob scales per-cell position, rotation, and scale jitter together — each hashed from the cell index in a single GLSL TOP so the pattern is stable and reproducible (the classic generative-design 'controlled randomness' / Schotter study, no external source). Set `outline: true` for line cells. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path`. Exposes the live Disorder knob plus CellColor/Background swatches. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with node paths, exposed controls, node errors, warnings, and an inline preview image.

background.description: Background colour hex. Live RGB swatch 'Background'.

cell_color.description: Cell / line colour hex (e.g. '#f2f2f2'). Live RGB swatch 'CellColor'.

cols.description: Number of grid columns (left to right).

disorder.description: The single order↔chaos knob. 0 = a perfect grid; 1 = full chaos. Scales all per-cell position/rotation/scale jitter together.

expose_controls.description: Expose the live Disorder knob (and CellColor/Background swatches).

fill.description: Cell size within its slot (0..1); leaves gutters between cells.

line_width.description: Outline thickness (fraction of a cell); used only when outline=true.

outline.description: Draw outlined cells instead of filled quads (classic Schotter look).

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the self-contained 'disorder_grid' container is created inside.

pos_jitter.description: Max per-cell position offset at disorder=1 (fraction of a cell).

resolution.description: Output resolution [width, height] of the GLSL TOP (square suits a grid).

rows.description: Number of grid rows (top to bottom).

scale_jitter.description: Max per-cell scale variation at disorder=1 (fraction).

name: controlled_disorder_grid
title: Controlled disorder grid
